brief: Goldman Sachs equity sales daily for 10 Sep 2026, mostly reporting rather than arguing. The tape: S&P 500 down 48bps at 7636 and up 11.6% year to date, which the note attributes to rising oil prices and higher yields. Brent $101 on ongoing Iran escalation, US 10-year 4.84% after Bessent's $6bn buyback came in smaller than expected, gold $4410, bitcoin $78k, Meta up 7% on its Muse agent launch. Two views carry chains. Mike Cahill: a firmer inflation print of +25bps, if sufficiently broad, would likely push the Fed to act because it would violate the parameters Williams and Waller set out over the summer, a softer 18-20bps print lets the Fed stand still, and the middle ground is harder because the market has shown discomfort with inflation near 2.5% and no Fed move. The bank expects a 25bps ECB hike today, fully priced, and thinks September is the last hike of the cycle. Also reported: Apple's $1999 foldable and $100 Pro price hike, called largely as expected and supportive of device demand, Google's EUR 13bn Finland AI investment, Uber's EUR 4.5bn euro bond debut, Zcash at $21bn, and an Anthropic researcher resigning with an AI risk warning.
